# Codemap - issue 0147, round 14: the pinned gap `equal-to-force-points-limit-border-patrol`

The issue fences the scope hard: only `src/evaluator/` and its unit tests may
change. Nothing under `docs/testing/` may be touched at all - its `.ros` files,
`scenario.json` and `README.md` are the specification.

What the scenario demands, in one sentence: a condition on the configured points
budget (`field="limit::ecfa-8486-4f6c-c249"`) must read that budget even when the
condition carries `scope="force"`, instead of failing closed with an
`UNRESOLVED_BUDGET_LIMIT` diagnostic. Three of the scenario's four cases are red
today (rosters 01, 02, 03); roster 04 is green and must stay green.

## Changes expected

- `src/evaluator/query.js` - the query primitive and the **only** place that
  resolves a `limit::<costTypeId>` field; `resolveLimitValue` (around line 229)
  turns every scope other than `roster` into the `UNRESOLVED_BUDGET` sentinel plus
  a diagnostic, and the same file already resolves the `force` frame for counting
  scopes (around line 172), so both halves of the question live here.
- `src/evaluator/model.js` - the shared vocabulary: the `UNRESOLVED_BUDGET`
  sentinel, `CountedFieldKind.LIMIT_VALUE`, `DiagnosticKind`, `ScopeKeyword` and
  `BudgetLimitUnresolvedReason` whose `NON_ROSTER_SCOPE` member and doc block
  encode exactly the rule the scenario contradicts.
- `src/evaluator/query.limitValue.test.js` - the unit test that pins today's rule;
  its `ScopeKeyword.FORCE` case (around line 85) asserts the diagnostic the
  scenario forbids.
- `src/evaluator/rosterBudget.js` - the roster-wide budget a `limit::` read
  resolves against, including its unlimited (`-1`) fail-closed path; whether a
  force frame needs anything of it is decided here.
- `src/evaluator/rosterBudget.unlimitedSentinel.test.js` - pins the unlimited
  budget's fail-closed resolution through a `limit::` read, so it moves with any
  change to how such a read resolves.

## Possibly involved - to confirm or rule out

- `src/evaluator/modifiers.js` - the consumer on the scenario's own path: the
  `set 1` modifier's condition fails closed on the `UNRESOLVED_BUDGET` sentinel
  (around lines 172, 207, 229, 331), which is why the raised minimum is dead code
  today.
- `src/evaluator/constraints.js` - the other sentinel consumer (percent
  denominator, suspended limit; around lines 52, 93, 129) and the place where a
  limit's own `roster`/`force` scope is already distinguished.
- `src/evaluator/catalogReader.js` - reads `field="limit::<id>"` into
  `LIMIT_VALUE` and reads the condition's `scope` attribute; only involved if the
  gap turns out to be in the reading rather than the resolution.
- `src/evaluator/violationClassification.js` - maps `LIMIT_VALUE` onto a limit
  measure and classifies the diagnostics the report carries.
- `src/evaluator/report.js` - projects diagnostics and slot values
  (`effectiveMin`, `current`, `effectiveMax`, `headroom`, `isBlocked`) that the
  scenario pins per roster.
- `src/evaluator/enumHandlerCoverage.test.js`,
  `src/evaluator/violationClassification.test.js` - enumerate the enums above and
  will need a line if a diagnostic reason is added, renamed or removed.
- `src/evaluator/CLAUDE.md` - the suite doc; a line only if a new test file is
  added to the directory.

## Read-only, never edited

- `docs/testing/equal-to-force-points-limit-border-patrol/` (`scenario.json`,
  `rosters/*.ros`, `README.md`) - the specification, explicitly out of scope.
- `src/evaluator/e2e.testcatalog.test.js` - the manifest-driven runner that turns
  every scenario under `docs/testing/` into cases; it is the check, never an edit.
- `src/evaluator/__fixtures__/whfb6-definitive/` - the frozen catalog data the
  scenario is derived from (the entry `2066-082d-a465-4baf` lives in
  `Mercenaries (6th definitive edition).cat`).
- `docs/testing/campaign-state.json` - the campaign driver's state; it pins this
  gap and lies outside the issue's fence, so the human moves it from `pinnedGaps`
  to closed when the campaign branch merges.
- `docs/evaluator-architecture.md` - describes the query primitive's contract
  (SS4.5, and the `LIMIT_VALUE` line around 170) and is already stale from earlier
  rounds; outside the fence, so it stays for the human to schedule.

increments.title: A budget-limit condition resolves in the force frame instead of failing closed
increments.goal: Make `docs/testing/equal-to-force-points-limit-border-patrol` green in all four of its cases. A condition reading the configured points budget (`field="limit::ecfa-8486-4f6c-c249"`) with `scope="force"` must resolve to the roster's configured budget - a `.ros` declares its budget only at the roster root, so a resolvable force frame yields exactly that number - instead of raising `UNRESOLVED_BUDGET_LIMIT` and suspending its consumer. That makes the catalog author's rule live: at a budget of exactly 500 the `equalTo 500` gate holds and the `set 1` modifier raises the entry's own minimum (`1a97-1579-ab05-a6d7`) so the occupied slot reports `effectiveMin` 1, while 499 and 501 leave it at the base 0 with no diagnostic. This is the whole of the issue's first acceptance criterion; the second one - every scenario green today stays green - is a constraint on it, not separate work.
criteria: `npx vitest run src/evaluator` passes the cases `Szenario: equal-to-force-points-limit-border-patrol > rosters/01-budget-500-selected-min-raised.ros`, `> rosters/02-budget-499-selected-min-unraised.ros` and `> rosters/03-budget-501-selected-min-unraised.ros`.

In roster 01 the slot for defId `2066-082d-a465-4baf` with anchorKind `occupied` reports `effectiveMin` 1, `current` 1, `effectiveMax` 1, `headroom` 0, `isHidden` false and `isBlocked` true; in rosters 02 and 03 the same slot reports `effectiveMin` 0 with the rest unchanged.

No `UNRESOLVED_BUDGET_LIMIT` diagnostic is raised in any of the four rosters, and the limits pinned `absent` by the scenario stay silent while the Core limit `35c2-d478-392a-aeb1` keeps firing with actual 0 against bound 2 in all four.
Roster `04-budget-500-unselected-no-anchor.ros` stays green: the raised minimum `1a97-1579-ab05-a6d7` still produces no anchor and stays silent.

A budget-limit read that genuinely cannot resolve - an unbudgeted cost type, an unlimited (`-1`) budget, or a frame the query cannot resolve - still fails closed with its diagnostic rather than silently answering 0; the unit tests that pin this are kept or replaced by equivalents, never weakened to let the scenario pass.
`npx vitest run src/evaluator` ends at exit 0 with no failure anywhere: every scenario the earlier rounds closed included, and no unit test of the evaluator suite skipped or deleted to get there.
Nothing outside `src/evaluator/` and its unit tests changes; no file under `docs/testing/` is touched.
